conferences.title: The 9th KIISC International Conference on Mobile Internet Security
conferences.description: MOBISEC 2025 (the 9th edition) brought together researchers, practitioners, and students from around the world to explore the evolution of Mobile Internet Security. The event featured original research papers, keynote sessions, and discussions on emerging topics including AI-driven business innovation, quantum computing, 6G networks, blockchain, and cybersecurity.
topics: Artificial Intelligence and Data-Driven Business Innovation
Blockchain, Decentralized Finance, and Web 3.0 Economies
Cybersecurity and Digital Trust in EBIS

conferences.title: The 8th International Conference on Mobile Internet Security
conferences.description: MOBISEC 2024 (the 8th edition) was hosted at Hotel Emisia Sapporo, the same venue later used for MOBISEC 2025. Organized by KIISC's Research Group on 5G Security together with Kookmin University's Cryptography & Information Security Institute, it brought together academics and industry professionals to exchange research on mobile internet security and cyber security applications.
conferences.proceedings: Springer Communications in Computer and Information Science (CCIS) — Revised Selected Papers

conferences.title: The 7th International Conference on Mobile Internet Security
conferences.description: MOBISEC 2023 was held at Novotel Okinawa Naha, featuring keynote speakers, committee sessions, and a lifetime achievement award presentation alongside the main research program.

conferences.title: The 6th International Symposium on Mobile Internet Security
conferences.description: MOBISEC 2022 returned to Jeju Island, continuing the symposium's focus on mobile internet security research, bringing together academics and industry professionals to exchange ideas on emerging security challenges.
conferences.proceedings: Springer Communications in Computer and Information Science (CCIS) — Revised Selected Papers

conferences.title: The 5th International Symposium on Mobile Internet Security
conferences.description: MOBISEC 2021 was held at the Jeju Oriental Hotel in a hybrid format, with authors presenting either on-site or online depending on pandemic-era travel conditions.
conferences.proceedings: Springer Communications in Computer and Information Science (CCIS) — Revised Selected Papers

conferences.title: The 4th International Symposium on Mobile Internet Security
conferences.description: MOBISEC 2019 returned to Taichung, hosted at Hotel National, addressing security threats in mobility management, distributed systems, IoT, and 5G networks.
conferences.proceedings: Research Briefs on ICT Evolution (ReBICTE); selected papers extended to Springer CCIS, IJAHUC, or IEEE Access
topics: Vulnerabilities and threats in mobile internet and networks
Security protocols and issues for mobile internet
Privacy and trust for mobile systems
Vertical handover security in heterogeneous networks
Mobile internet services and applications security

conferences.title: The 3rd International Symposium on Mobile Internet Security
conferences.description: MOBISEC 2018 was held in Cebu, Philippines, addressing emerging security challenges in distributed mobility management, mobile internet of things, and 5G networks.
conferences.organizedBy: KIISC Research Group on 5G Security, University of San Carlos

conferences.title: The 2nd International Symposium on Mobile Internet Security

conferences.description: The inaugural MOBISEC symposium was held in Taichung, Taiwan, in cooperation with the SCH Lab. of Mobile Internet Security and KIISC's Smart Media Convergence SIG, establishing the research series that continues through MOBISEC 2026.
